svg.title: ARMOR-NODE-HMI architecture
svg.desc: The firmware of ARMOR-NODE-HMI drives a 7-inch touch screen, a speaker and four microphones on a Waveshare ESP32-S3 board, shows the summary that ARMOR-SERVER sends, marks it stale when it is old and never shows the duress alarm. The firmware has been built once with ESP-IDF 5.5.5 and has never run on a board.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: The touch panel of the house: it shows what the server knows, takes the PIN on the screen and talks to the assistant; it carries out no command by itself.
